"""Ignored, fixed-stage orchestration for Issue 47; scientific APIs stay unchanged."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WORK = ROOT / ".work/primary-learning"
OUT = ROOT / "artifacts/transformer-nlc"
RUN = OUT / "principal-learning-20261025"
TRAIN_PY = Path("/home/kamimura/projects/optical-comm-lab/.work/worktrees/transformer-model/.venv/bin/python")
DATA_PY = Path("/home/kamimura/projects/optical-comm-lab/.venv/bin/python")
GPU_LOCK = Path("/home/kamimura/projects/optical-comm-lab/.work/orchestration/gpu.lock")
QUAL_ROOT = Path("/home/kamimura/projects/optical-comm-lab/.work/worktrees/transformer-data/artifacts/transformer-nlc")
QUAL_HASHES = {16:"ef8ef5c85c5d0f94d52e324ce27966388bf5f9257299a8522c18872002314d4b",64:"0c45ebb90591f920dd35dd7f3c19ca4546a4f0f4d9ec0a762c99b3096811e8ba"}
NUMERICAL_HASH = "4ba57a9e4a401a11a16c4241eb6ea3db253ef59c32b2c9ac38c0e5676e01f74e"
ENV = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=f"{ROOT}/src:{ROOT}", PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1", CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8")

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def write(path, data):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp = path.with_name(path.name + f".{os.getpid()}.tmp")
    with temp.open("w") as stream:
        json.dump(data, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    temp.replace(path)

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())

def qualification(condition):
    path = QUAL_ROOT / f"qualification-main{condition}-20261025/qualification.json"
    assert digest(path) == QUAL_HASHES[condition], "Qualification bytes changed"
    data = read(path)
    assert data["status"] == "passed" and len(data["frames"]) == 18
    assert data["source_content_sha256"] == NUMERICAL_HASH
    return path

def verify_source():
    from experiments.transformer_nlc.checkpoint import code_identity
    from experiments.transformer_nlc.data import numerical_source_identity
    actual = code_identity()
    assert numerical_source_identity()["content_sha256"] == NUMERICAL_HASH
    assert all(Path(p).is_relative_to(ROOT) for p in actual["source_layout"]["module_paths"].values())
    frozen = WORK / "source-freeze.json"
    if frozen.exists():
        assert actual["content_sha256"] == read(frozen)["content_sha256"], "Training source changed"
    else:
        write(frozen, actual)
    return actual

def compare_resume(condition):
    import torch
    from experiments.transformer_nlc.checkpoint import load_checkpoint
    from experiments.transformer_nlc.training_config import TrainingConfig
    config = TrainingConfig.from_dict(read(WORK / f"configs/resume-main{condition}.json"))
    base = OUT / f"resume-verification-main{condition}-20261025"
    cont, resumed = base / "continuous", base / "resumed"
    a, b = load_checkpoint(cont / "latest.pt"), load_checkpoint(resumed / "latest.pt")
    maxima = {"floating_tensor_max_abs":0., "scalar_max_abs":0.}
    checked = {"tensors":0,"scalars":0}
    def compare(x,y,key):
        if isinstance(x, torch.Tensor):
            assert isinstance(y,torch.Tensor) and x.dtype == y.dtype and x.shape == y.shape, key
            checked["tensors"] += 1
            if x.is_floating_point():
                delta = float((x-y).abs().max()) if x.numel() else 0.
                maxima["floating_tensor_max_abs"] = max(maxima["floating_tensor_max_abs"],delta)
                assert torch.allclose(x,y,atol=config.gpu_resume_atol,rtol=config.gpu_resume_rtol), key
            else:
                assert torch.equal(x,y), key
        elif isinstance(x,dict):
            assert set(x)==set(y),key
            for k in x:
                if k != "seconds":
                    compare(x[k],y[k],f"{key}.{k}")
        elif isinstance(x,(list,tuple)):
            assert len(x)==len(y),key
            for i,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x,y)):
                compare(u,v,f"{key}[{i}]")
        elif isinstance(x,float):
            checked["scalars"]+=1
            maxima["scalar_max_abs"]=max(maxima["scalar_max_abs"],abs(x-y))
            assert math.isclose(x,y,abs_tol=config.gpu_resume_atol,rel_tol=config.gpu_resume_rtol),key
        else:
            assert x==y,(key,x,y)
    fields=("model","optimizer","scheduler","epoch","optimizer_step","sampler","rng","best_validation_mse","patience_used","history","config","identities")
    for field in fields:
        compare(a[field],b[field],field)
    for directory in (cont,resumed):
        record=read(directory/"run.json")
        checkpoint=load_checkpoint(directory/"best.pt",expected_sha256=record["checkpoints"]["best"]["sha256"])
        model_config=config.model
        from experiments.transformer_nlc.model import TransformerNLC
        from experiments.transformer_nlc.training import BlockDataset, read_manifest, _validate
        from experiments.transformer_nlc.checkpoint import configure_runtime, device_lock
        configure_runtime(config)
        with device_lock(config.device):
            model=TransformerNLC(model_config).to(config.device)
            model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model"])
            manifest,data,_=read_manifest(record["data_manifest"])
            dataset=BlockDataset(manifest,data,"validation",model_config,validation_symbols=2048)
            value=_validate(model,dataset,config)
            assert math.isclose(value,record["best_validation_mse"],abs_tol=config.gpu_resume_atol,rel_tol=config.gpu_resume_rtol)
    result={"schema":"transformer-gpu-resume-verification-v1","status":"passed","condition":condition,
            "atol":config.gpu_resume_atol,"rtol":config.gpu_resume_rtol,"excluded_history_field":"seconds (wall time)",
            "compared_checkpoint_fields":fields,"checked":checked,"maxima":maxima,
            "continuous_latest_sha256":digest(cont/"latest.pt"),"resumed_latest_sha256":digest(resumed/"latest.pt"),
            "continuous_run":str(cont/"run.json"),"resumed_run":str(resumed/"run.json"),
            "best_checkpoint_GPU_reload_validation":"passed", "selection_use":"verification only; excluded from 4 learning pilots and 36 production trials"}
    write(base/"verification.json",result)
    print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)

def compare_evaluation():
    a=read(OUT/"principal-evaluation-20261025/metrics.json")
    b=read(OUT/"principal-evaluation-reload-20261025/metrics.json")
    assert a["status"]==b["status"]=="complete"
    assert a["freeze_sha256"]==b["freeze_sha256"]
    assert len(a["frames"])==len(b["frames"])
    for x,y in zip(a["frames"],b["frames"]):
        for key in ("method","condition","candidate","masked","replicate","frame","metrics"):
            assert x[key]==y[key],(key,x["method"])
    write(RUN/"checkpoint-reload-verification.json",{"status":"passed","frame_predictions":len(a["frames"]),"comparison":"all frame metrics exact after independent frozen checkpoint reload","freeze_sha256":a["freeze_sha256"],"first":str(OUT/"principal-evaluation-20261025/metrics.json"),"reload":str(OUT/"principal-evaluation-reload-20261025/metrics.json")})

def worker(args):
    verify_source()
    if args[0]=="resume-compare":
        compare_resume(int(args[1]))
    elif args[0]=="evaluation-compare":
        compare_evaluation()
    elif args[0]=="identity":
        print(read(WORK/"source-freeze.json")["content_sha256"],flush=True)
    else:
        from experiments.transformer_nlc.__main__ import main
        raise SystemExit(main(args))

def main():
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    RUN.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    lock=(WORK/"orchestrator.lock").open("a+")
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    lock.seek(0); lock.truncate(); lock.write(str(os.getpid())); lock.flush()
    state_path=WORK/"job-state.json"
    state=read(state_path) if state_path.exists() else {"schema":"transformer-primary-job-v1","stages":[],"created_unix":time.time()}
    state.update(status="running",pid=os.getpid(),runner=str(Path(__file__)),runner_sha256=digest(__file__),workdir=str(ROOT),log=str(WORK/"runner.log"),orchestrator_lock=str(WORK/"orchestrator.lock"),gpu_lock=str(GPU_LOCK),reserve_disk_bytes=20*2**30)
    write(state_path,state)
    def execute(stage,command,complete=None,allow_oom=False):
        existing=next((s for s in state["stages"] if s["id"]==stage and s["status"]=="complete"),None)
        if existing:
            assert complete is None or Path(complete).exists(),f"Missing completed stage output: {stage}"
            return
        assert shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free>state["reserve_disk_bytes"],"Disk reserve reached"
        for logical,sha in read(WORK/"source-freeze.json")["files"].items() if (WORK/"source-freeze.json").exists() else []:
            assert digest(ROOT/logical)==sha,f"Source changed: {logical}"
        logfile=WORK/f"{stage}.log"
        entry={"id":stage,"status":"running","command":command,"command_sha256":hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(command).encode()).hexdigest(),"log":str(logfile),"started_unix":time.time(),"disk_free_before":shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free}
        state["stages"].append(entry);state["active_stage"]=stage
        with logfile.open("a") as stream:
            proc=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT,env=ENV,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            entry["pid"]=proc.pid
            while proc.poll() is None:
                state["updated_unix"]=time.time();write(state_path,state)
                time.sleep(10)
        entry.update(returncode=proc.returncode,ended_unix=time.time(),status="complete" if proc.returncode==0 else "failed",disk_free_after=shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free)
        write(state_path,state)
        print(json.dumps(entry),flush=True)
        if proc.returncode!=0:
            if allow_oom and complete and Path(complete).exists() and read(complete).get("oom"):
                return "oom"
            raise RuntimeError(f"Stage {stage} failed with {proc.returncode}; see {logfile}")
    def training(stage,args,complete=None,allow_oom=False):
        return execute(stage,[str(TRAIN_PY),str(Path(__file__)),"--worker",*map(str,args)],complete,allow_oom)
    try:
        for c in (16,64):qualification(c)
        training("00-source-identity",["identity"],WORK/"source-freeze.json")
        for c in (16,64):
            for masked in (False,True):
                for micro in (512,256,128,64):
                    run=f"resource-main{c}-{'masked' if masked else 'unmasked'}-micro{micro}-20261025"
                    result=training(f"01-{run}",["benchmark","--condition",c,"--masked" if masked else "--unmasked","--device","cuda","--microbatch-blocks",micro,"--run-id",run,"--output-root",OUT],OUT/run/"resource-benchmark.json",True)
                    if result!="oom":break
                else:raise RuntimeError("All resource microbatches exhausted")
        for c in (16,64):
            run=f"learning-pilot-data-main{c}-20261025"
            out=OUT/run
            args=[str(DATA_PY),"-m","experiments.transformer_nlc.data_cli","generate","--condition",str(c),"--pilot","--scored-symbols","4096","--backend","cupy","--run-id",run,"--output-root",str(OUT)]
            if (out/"manifest.json").exists() and read(out/"manifest.json")["status"]!="complete":args.append("--resume")
            execute(f"02-{run}",["flock","-n",str(GPU_LOCK),*args],out/"manifest.json")
            for masked in (False,True):
                run=f"learning-pilot-main{c}-{'masked' if masked else 'unmasked'}-20261025"
                training(f"03-{run}",["train","--config",ROOT/f"experiments/transformer_nlc/configs/learning-pilot-main{c}-{'masked' if masked else 'unmasked'}.json","--data-manifest",out/"manifest.json","--run-id",run,"--output-root",OUT],OUT/run/"run.json")
        for c in (16,64):
            config=read(ROOT/f"experiments/transformer_nlc/configs/learning-pilot-main{c}-masked.json")
            conf=WORK/f"configs/resume-main{c}.json";write(conf,config)
            base=OUT/f"resume-verification-main{c}-20261025"
            data=OUT/f"learning-pilot-data-main{c}-20261025/manifest.json"
            common=["train","--config",conf,"--data-manifest",data,"--output-root",base]
            training(f"04-resume-main{c}-continuous",[*common,"--run-id","continuous"],base/"continuous/run.json")
            training(f"04-resume-main{c}-pause",[*common,"--run-id","resumed","--stop-after-epochs",2],base/"resumed/run.json")
            training(f"04-resume-main{c}-resume",[*common,"--run-id","resumed","--resume"],base/"resumed/run.json")
            training(f"04-resume-main{c}-compare",["resume-compare",c],base/"verification.json")
        resources=[read(p) for p in OUT.glob("resource-main*-20261025/resource-benchmark.json")]
        pilots=[read(OUT/f"learning-pilot-main{c}-{m}-20261025/run.json") for c in (16,64) for m in ("masked","unmasked")]
        assert len(pilots)==4 and all(p["status"]=="complete" and p["completed_epochs"]==5 for p in pilots)
        estimate={"schema":"transformer-primary-production-gate-v1","status":"passed","test_metrics_seen":False,
                  "source_content_sha256":read(WORK/"source-freeze.json")["content_sha256"],"qualification":{str(c):{"path":str(qualification(c)),"sha256":QUAL_HASHES[c]} for c in (16,64)},
                  "resources":[{"condition":r["config"]["condition"],"masked":r["config"]["masked"],"microbatch":r["microbatch_blocks"],"status":r["status"],"seconds":r["seconds"],"peak_allocated_GPU_bytes":r.get("peak_allocated_GPU_bytes")} for r in resources],
                  "pilots":[{"condition":p["config"]["condition"],"masked":p["config"]["masked"],"epochs":p["completed_epochs"],"epoch_seconds":[h["seconds"] for h in p["history"]],"peak_allocated_GPU_bytes":p["peak_allocated_GPU_bytes"],"validation_generated":4096,"validation_used":2048} for p in pilots],
                  "fixed_trials":36,"max_epochs":500,"effective_batch_blocks":512,"microbatch_blocks":512,
                  "production_training_seconds_upper_planning_estimate":sum(r["seconds"]*8*500*3 for r in resources if r["status"]=="passed")*1.5,
                  "estimate_limit":"single synthetic update is a rough planning proxy; includes initialization and is not a speedup result; smaller candidates differ; actual epoch telemetry is authoritative",
                  "disk_free_bytes":shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free,"disk_reserve_bytes":20*2**30,"validator_requested_attempted_completed":[0,0,0]}
        write(RUN/"production-gate.json",estimate)
        manifests=[]
        for c in (16,64):
            for replicate in range(3):
                run=f"data-main{c}-r{replicate}-20261025"
                out=OUT/run
                args=[str(DATA_PY),"-m","experiments.transformer_nlc.data_cli","generate","--condition",str(c),"--replicate",str(replicate),"--backend","cupy","--run-id",run,"--output-root",str(OUT),"--qualification",str(qualification(c))]
                if (out/"manifest.json").exists() and read(out/"manifest.json")["status"]!="complete":args.append("--resume")
                execute(f"05-{run}",["flock","-n",str(GPU_LOCK),*args],out/"manifest.json")
                assert read(out/"manifest.json")["status"]=="complete"
                manifests.append(out/"manifest.json")
        sweep=OUT/"principal-sweep-20261025"
        args=["sweep","--data-manifest",*manifests,"--regime","production","--device","cuda","--microbatch-blocks",512,"--run-id",sweep.name,"--output-root",OUT]
        if (sweep/"ledger.json").exists():args.append("--resume")
        training("06-production-sweep",args,sweep/"ledger.json")
        ledger=read(sweep/"ledger.json")
        assert ledger["status"]=="complete" and len(ledger["trials"])==36
        training("07-selection-freeze",["freeze","--ledger",sweep/"ledger.json","--run-id","principal-selection-20261025","--output-root",OUT],OUT/"principal-selection-20261025/selection-freeze.json")
        for name in ("principal-evaluation-20261025","principal-evaluation-reload-20261025"):
            training(f"08-{name}",["evaluate","--freeze",OUT/"principal-selection-20261025/selection-freeze.json","--device","cuda","--run-id",name,"--output-root",OUT],OUT/name/"metrics.json")
            training(f"09-recount-{name}",["recount","--metrics",OUT/name/"metrics.json"])
        training("10-checkpoint-reload-compare",["evaluation-compare"],RUN/"checkpoint-reload-verification.json")
        state.update(status="complete",active_stage=None,ended_unix=time.time())
    except BaseException as exc:
        state.update(status="failed",exception=type(exc).__name__,message=str(exc),traceback=traceback.format_exc(),ended_unix=time.time())
        traceback.print_exc()
    finally:
        write(state_path,state)
        write(RUN/"execution-state.json",state)
    if state["status"]!="complete":raise SystemExit(1)

if __name__=="__main__":
    if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=="--worker":worker(sys.argv[2:])
    else:main()
